title: Supervisor initiates a corporation tax case
description: The supervisor opens the case register, starts a new GB CIT case for the accounting period ending 31 March 2025, and confirms the taxpayer reference.
expected: A case exists in status INITIATED, owned by the supervisor who created it.

title: The assessing officer cannot approve their own assessment
description: Signed in as the officer who prepared the assessment, the approval action is requested against the same case.
expected: The server refuses with 403 and the approval control is absent from the officer's view. Preparer and approver are never the same person.

title: The domain event ledger records the case history
description: The administrator opens the case audit trail and reads the events the run has produced so far.
expected: Every lifecycle move above appears once in the ledger, in order, with the actor that drove it.
